set.body:
Phase A (P1 correctness hotfix, no public shape change).

Problem: cli/SlurmCommands.scala:111 appends user-supplied native options AFTER every typed site option, and submit (:23-36) places siteArguments after the renderer-owned --job-name, --output, --error and after resourceArguments. sbatch takes the LAST occurrence of a repeated option, so a native option named output, error, job-name, cpus-per-task, mem, time, account, partition, qos, constraint, gres or parsable silently overrides the typed value — including --output/--error, which breaks the log-path contract the planner established, and --parsable, which breaks SbatchParsable.parse.

NativeOption.from (core/SiteProfile.scala:36-45) validates name SYNTAX ([a-z][a-z0-9-]*) but not name OWNERSHIP. The only gate is the allowlist allowedNativeOptions (:130, default Set.empty) checked by validateNativeOptions (:301-314) — an allowlist, not a denylist of renderer-owned keys. An operator who allows "output" gets a silent override with no diagnostic.

Mitigating nuance (why P1 not P0): EffectiveSiteSpec only exists via submitAt (cli/SlurmCliScheduler.scala:30-46), so plain submit never carries native options, and the default empty allowlist rejects everything.

Fix: reject renderer-owned keys with a typed diagnostic, independent of the allowlist. Only --export and --array currently render after siteArguments and are safe.

Acceptance: test that an allowlisted native "output" is rejected with a typed failure. RED against parent.
set.title: P8.A6: Reserve renderer-owned native option keys
